verdict.rationale: Vercel's docs state that teams and invited collaborators can comment on preview and production environments, which matches the story exactly. The in-browser toolbar for leaving feedback and the marketplace integrations that route comments to Slack, GitHub, Jira and Linear corroborate that commenting is a first-party feature. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of commenting mechanics (threads, permissions, invite flow), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can let teammates and collaborators comment directly on preview and production environments

citations.quote: Let teams and invited collaborators comment on your preview and production environments.
An in-browser toolbar to leave feedback, manage flags, preview drafts, and inspect performance.
